positions.title: Senior Mobile Software Developer
positions.description:
Mobile Retail Solution responsibilities and duties including the following -
* Programmed Objective-C on a daily basis
* Acted as Scrum Master for the development team including administration of JIRA tasks and reporting
* Contributed to associate facing retail mobile solutions and authored a consumer facing version of the software
* Daily interaction with Subversion, Jenkins,and unit testing iOS code for both the products platforms and extensions
* Designed and implemented new functionality workflows and functionality
* Held knowledge workshops with other team members on development and business topics
Advanced Store software engineer responsibilities and duties including the following -
*Programmed .NET/C# code on a daily basis for use in creation of companies next generation point-of-sale application.
*Experience using WPF, XAML, MVVC, and WCF during application development.
*Worked on all aspects of the project including platform, POS application, server, and mobile.
*Wrote and designed several platform applications seeing them through from concept phase to release.
*Programmed C++ code on a daily basis for advanced store legacy point-of-sale application.
*Architected, project managed, and developed the iOS mobile POS offering for the 5.x  point-of-sale application.
*Wrote and managed code for legacy windows mobile platform point-of-sale application.
*Used continuous delivery and unit testing to ensure high quality/low defect code.
*Used scrum techniques for project management of the next-gen and iOS projects.
*Attended multiple Agile/Scrum training courses.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Software Engineer/Developer for multiple library print and time management software applications.
* Programmed C++ code on a daily basis.
* Worked with QT on a daily basis.
* Directly involved with architecture and design aspects for all applications.
* Followed agile and extreme programming processes including test driven development and pair programming.
* Worked closely with customer support to implement bug fixes and enhancements when needed.

positions.title: Network Operations Supervisor
positions.description:
* Shift Supervisor for Network Operations.
* Supervise staff of approximately 14 Master Control Operators.
* Aggressively monitor system for highest quality signal.
* Control and edit active playlists to insure on-air quality.
* Troubleshoot and correct problems that may arise within DOS and Win2k based client/server network system.
* Troubleshoot and correct any hardware/software problems that may arise.
* Enter and edit information in the database.
* Interact with clients and staff.
